dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.setupIntro: Build the identity first, then add products and arrange the storefront. Each card opens the exact place to make that change.
dashboard.identityDescription: Name, logo, accent color and the details customers see.
dashboard.catalogDescription: Photos, price, options and availability on product pages.
dashboard.collectionsDescription: Group products into pages customers can browse.
dashboard.homepageDescription: Choose the hero and sections, then preview both languages.
dashboard.storyDescription: Write the About page in both languages so customers know the brand.
dashboard.policiesDescription: Add shipping, returns, privacy and terms in both languages.
dashboard.ordersDescription: Send new orders to your Telegram destination.

products.title: Products
products.editorIntroTitle: Make each piece easy to discover
products.editorIntro: Add its name in both languages, a clear price and a cover image. Save as a draft while you work; set it active when you want customers to see it.
products.detailsHint: The English name suggests the product URL until you edit the URL yourself. Names and descriptions appear on the product page in the selected language.
products.pricingHint: These values appear on product cards and at checkout. Stock can stay empty if you do not track quantity.
products.compareAtHint: Optional. Enter a higher original price to show a sale price.
products.sortOrderHint: Lower numbers are shown first when the default order is used.
products.galleryHint: The first image is the cover in product grids. Reorder images below to change the cover; shoppers can view the others on the product page.
products.variantsHint: Optional. Add a group such as Size or Color, then its values in both languages. Shoppers choose a value before adding the item to their bag.
products.visibilityHint: Draft stays out of the storefront. New arrival and Featured control their matching homepage sections; collections place this product on those collection pages.
products.collectionsHint: A product can belong to more than one collection.
products.imagesHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF · max 8 MB each · first image is the cover
products.noCollections: No collections yet — create one first

collections.title: Collections
collections.editorIntroTitle: Give pieces a place to belong
collections.editorIntro: Name the collection in both languages, choose its leading image, then select the products it should contain. Save and open the page to review the result.
collections.detailsHint: The English name suggests the URL until you edit it yourself. The description appears at the top of the collection page.
collections.slugHint: Suggested from the English name. Use lowercase letters and hyphens.
collections.imageHint: This image introduces the collection on its page and in homepage highlights. Adjust the crop separately for desktop and mobile.
collections.visibilityHint: Hide a collection to keep it saved without showing it to shoppers.
collections.sortOrderHint: Lower numbers come first in collection listings.

homeSections.title: Homepage sections
homeSections.listIntroTitle: Build the page in reading order
homeSections.listIntro: Each row controls one storefront section. Open it to change text, images, visibility or order; then check the live page.
homeSections.emptyDescription: Add a Hero section to introduce the brand, then add product and story sections as your catalog grows.
homeSections.typeHint: Choose what this section should show. Its type stays fixed after saving so existing content is preserved.
homeSections.visibilityHint: Turn this off to keep the section saved without showing it to customers.
homeSections.contentHint: The fields below become the text, links and items in this section.
homeSections.presentationHint: Choose the composition and adjust the image without changing the original file. Check desktop, mobile, English and Arabic in the preview below.
homeSections.purposeHero: The first impression at the top of the homepage: a headline, image and one clear action.
homeSections.purposeFeatured: A curated row of the products you select, independent of their catalog order.
homeSections.purposeCollectionHighlight: A focused introduction to one collection with its imagery and products.
homeSections.purposeNewArrivals: Automatically shows active products marked as new arrivals.
homeSections.purposeLookbookPreview: Shows visible editorial images from your lookbook.
homeSections.purposeBrandStory: A short story and image that explain what makes the brand distinct.
homeSections.purposePromoBanner: A final campaign message with an optional image and action.
homeSections.headline: Headline
homeSections.ctaHrefHint: Use a store path such as /collections. The current language is added automatically.

about.title: About Us page
about.editorIntro: This page is linked from the storefront. Write your story in English and Arabic so neither language shows an unfinished message.
about.storyHint: Keep the opening clear: what you make, why it matters and what customers can expect.
about.imagesHint: The first image leads the page beside your story. The remaining images form an editorial gallery below.

policies.title: Policies
policies.editorIntroTitle: Make the store ready to trust
policies.editorIntro: Complete shipping, returns, privacy and terms in both languages. Each tab is a separate page linked in the storefront footer.
policies.tabHint: Save this page before opening another tab. Each policy is saved separately.
policies.visibleHint: Only visible policies appear in the footer. Review the content before making a policy visible.

branding.title: Branding & Settings
branding.identityIntro: Start with the name, logo and signature color. The preview updates while you edit; save to apply the changes across the storefront. Then set contact, language and delivery details.
branding.identityHint: The names and logo appear in the header and footer. The accent color is used for selected actions throughout the store.
branding.previewHint: A quick unsaved preview of the current name, logo, tagline and accent. Open the store after saving to check full pages.
branding.contactHint: Customers see these details in the footer and can use them to reach your store.
branding.socialHint: Only links you enter are shown. Use full https:// addresses.
branding.localeHint: The default language opens at the store root. Currency labels appear with prices in their matching language.
branding.shippingHint: These values affect the checkout total and the governorate choices customers see.
branding.logoHint: Displayed in header & footer. A wide, simple mark works best.
branding.faviconHint: Square image, shown in the browser tab.
branding.governoratesHint: One per line, format: English | Arabic
branding.storefrontPreview: Changes appear on the store immediately after saving.

telegram.title: Telegram orders
telegram.intro: Orders are delivered to your Telegram bot. Create a bot with @BotFather, then paste the token below.
telegram.botTokenHint: From @BotFather. Stored encrypted — never exposed to the browser.
telegram.botTokenKeep: Configured ({hint}). Leave empty to keep the current token.
telegram.chatIdHint: Send a message to your bot, then use @userinfobot or a channel's numeric ID.
telegram.notConfigured: Telegram is not configured yet. Orders will be saved and retried automatically.
telegram.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds}s.
telegram.step1: Open @BotFather in Telegram and send /newbot. Copy the token it gives you.
telegram.step2: Send any message to your new bot (this enables it to message you).
telegram.step3: Open @userinfobot and send any message — it replies with your numeric chat ID.
telegram.step4: Paste both values here and send a test message.

media.title: Images
media.drop: Drop images here, or choose files
media.formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF · Up to 8 MB each
media.recommendHint: Other sizes are welcome. Review the framing before saving.
media.libraryHint: Reuse an uploaded image. Choosing it here does not change other placements.
media.libraryError: The library could not load. Try again.
media.search: Search by image number or dimensions
media.networkError: Connection lost. Check your connection and retry.
media.rateLimited: Too many uploads. Wait a few minutes, then retry.
media.waitToSave: Images are uploading. Wait for them to finish before saving.
media.ready: Images are ready. Save this form to publish your selection.
media.limit: You can select up to {count} images.
media.cropHint: Fills the frame without distortion. Some edges may be cropped.
media.containHint: Keeps the entire image visible. Space may remain around it.
media.positionHint: Positioning affects only this placement. If the photo already matches the frame, the difference may be small.
media.mobileHint: Use a portrait composition for narrow screens, or leave empty to reuse the main image.
media.lowResolution: This image is smaller than recommended and may look soft on larger screens.
media.previewHint: Unsaved preview. Check both languages and screen sizes before saving.
media.emptyTitle: A new chapter is taking shape
media.emptyBody: Our collection is being prepared. Discover the story behind the maison.
media.noImage: Add an image to see the composition.
media.invalidFileType: Choose a valid JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF image.
